_about: Real commercial charge-pump PLL / frequency-synthesizer ICs. Every numeric field is taken from (or directly derived from) the manufacturer datasheet cited in `datasheet`. Where a value is band-dependent or not published as a single number, it is marked in `source_notes` and should be treated as a representative default the user can override. This library is the real-data anchor for LockBench: designs and predictions can be sanity-checked against the datasheet's own published specs.

devices.name: ADF4351
devices.category: Integer-N / Fractional-N RF synthesizer with integrated VCO
devices.source_notes: Kvco = 40 MHz/V (nominal; rises across the upper VCO bands). Icp programmable in 16 steps 0.31-5.0 mA with RSET = 5.1 kOhm; design recommended at the mid 2.5 mA setting. VCO fundamental 2.2-4.4 GHz; RF output down to 35 MHz via the /1../64 output divider. Phase noise -104 dBc/Hz at 3 kHz offset, 1 GHz carrier.

devices.name: LMX2594
devices.category: Wideband Fractional-N RF synthesizer with integrated VCO
devices.source_notes: Output 10 MHz-15 GHz with no internal doubler; VCO core fundamental 7.5-15 GHz (lower outputs via dividers). PFD up to 300 MHz (fractional) / 400 MHz (integer). Normalized PLL noise floor (FOM) -236 dBc/Hz. Kvco is strongly band-dependent (multiple VCO cores); 20 MHz/V is a representative mid-band default to override per band. Icp values are the datasheet's programmable charge-pump gain settings (representative).

devices.name: ADF5355
devices.category: Wideband Fractional-N synthesizer with integrated VCO
devices.source_notes: VCO fundamental 3.4-6.8 GHz; output 54 MHz-13.6 GHz via doubler and /1../64 dividers. PFD up to 125 MHz. Icp programmable 16 steps (same RSET scheme as the ADF435x family). Kvco is band-dependent; 55 MHz/V is a representative default to override. Verify exact Kvco-vs-band and Icp against the datasheet before final design.
